delta: The DE4SDV relation names the same fact the native construct expresses: which varying element a variation governs. Target realization is derived navigation over native variation/variant membership, not a declared YAML edge; no sysml_mapping should be added for a YAML-authored edge.
target_authority: model-authoritative via native variation structure (DE4SDV relation identity kept as navigation vocabulary only).
target_definition: variesAt = derived relation: a feature varies at the variation whose variants offer/deny it; resolved from native VariationMembership/VariantMembership facts once feature usages participate in variations. Until then, retained as declared vocabulary with no runtime claim.
rationale: This is the one PLE relationship with genuine native grounding: the variation construct is exactly the 'varies at' fact. Keeping it as a declared YAML edge would duplicate native semantics; inventing a variation-point part taxonomy is explicitly prohibited (kernel file:8-11). Correct move: keep the identity, realize as derived traversal, and never claim a fact without a native witness. If witnesses never appear, the row stays vocabulary-only (no negative meaning from missing implementation).

normative_reference.reference: SysML 2.0 §7.6.7 p. 75: variant usages enumerate the allowed choices of a variation (the object of selection)
SysML 2.0 §8.4.2.3 p. 435; VariantMembership p. 309

delta: The selected object is a native variant usage; the selecting side is external configuration data. No model relationship is created now; any future model-native realization (choice recorded in a configured product context) must use native variant structure, not a new relationship kind.
target_authority: external-reference for the operational selection (BoF YAML / generated projection); native variant structure owns the choice space.
target_definition: Configuration selects among native variant usages; recorded in the configuration layer. When model-native configured products are ever derived, the selection must ground in native variant choice/redefinition semantics.
rationale: The range is native (variant choice), so the relation is grounded in native semantics rather than invented; but the subject is the external configuration layer, so operationally it stays an external reference. This keeps the small architecture coherent: FeatureConfiguration and its edges stay external; only the target vocabulary is native. Existing config authority unchanged; no forced PLEML reuse.
